FitnessCoachAI — Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Last updated: 18 May 2026 1. Acceptance of Terms By creating an account or using FitnessCoachAI you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the app. 2. The Service FitnessCoachAI is a fitness coaching application that uses AI to generate weekly training plans, analyze your exercise form via the device camera, and answer your training questions. The app is for general fitness guidance only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. 3. Health Disclaimer Consult a qualified physician before starting any new exercise program, especially if you have injuries, pregnancy, cardiovascular conditions, or any chronic medical condition. Stop immediately and seek medical attention if you feel pain, dizziness, shortness of breath, or any abnormal symptom during a workout. 4. Account & Data You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential. We collect: • Profile data you provide during onboarding (age, height, weight, goal, fitness level, limitations). • Workout sessions you complete (reps, duration, form score). • Chat history with the AI coach. • Optional profile photo. Your data is stored on secure servers and is used only to personalize your training experience. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. 5. AI-Generated Content Training plans, recommendations and chat replies are generated by AI (Gemini). They may contain inaccuracies and should be reviewed with your own judgement. We are not liable for decisions you make based on AI output. 6. Camera & On-Device Processing Form analysis runs locally on your device using on-device machine learning. Camera frames are not uploaded to our servers. Only computed metrics (rep counts, form scores) are sent to the backend. 7. Subscription & Free Use The current version of the app is free during the diploma evaluation period. We reserve the right to introduce paid plans in future versions. 8. Termination You may delete your account at any time from Settings. Account deletion removes your profile, workout history, and chat conversations within 30 days. 9. Contact For questions, bug reports, or data requests, please email the developer. 10. Changes to These Terms We may update these Terms occasionally. Continued use of the app after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the new Terms. By using FitnessCoachAI you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted the terms above.
